entries.title: Unitree Go2
entries.content:
Unitree Go2

Documentation of the mapping and navigation work on the Unitree Go2 robot.

Mapping stack

The packages that turn the Go2’s lidar into a map, and the topics between them.



Saving a map

map_builder keeps every scan in memory and writes the files only when the session ends.
